title: Negative demonstrative statements review
focus: Mix singular negatives, plural negatives, and controlled affirmative-to-negative transformations.

exercises.prompt: Choose the sentence that means “The book is not here.” Use se kirja (“the book”) and täällä (“here”).
exercises.explanation: Se kirja is singular and therefore takes ei ole.
